description: Politecnico di Torino and Niger partners publish flood-risk inputs and results for a 931 square-kilometre rural area upstream of Niamey. Version 6 combines local and Guinean river floods at ten-, thirty- and hundred-year return periods with exposed crops and buildings, expected damage, risk-reduction options and cost-benefit estimates. Mendeley Data provides Excel tables, shapefiles and map figures freely under CC BY 4.0. Sources include hydraulic modelling, February 2024 imagery, 2025 field checks and municipal discussions. The regional package can benchmark flood-loss and emergency-planning simulations. Assumed damage functions and local asset valuations mean transfer elsewhere is limited. No directly related catalogue dataset was identified.
